build_wiring: Read the four local integration candidates and current durable queue/claim/return evidence; do not infer authority from UI state.

Normalize queue opportunity status -> state before derive-worker-demand; compute dependencies_satisfied, active_claim_ids, collision/authority/privacy/identity/owner flags from durable evidence rather than defaults.
Call deriveSurfaceWorkerDemand once per stable surface_id and map usefulFreeSlots -> surface.capacity.usefulFreeSlots and basis -> surface.capacity.basis.
Bind preview.href only when SURFACE_REGISTRY_CANDIDATE_V1 public_route.state is KNOWN from exact authority; while UNRESOLVED, preview.href MUST be null.
Keep local planner/steward ownership per surface. Shared worker kernel, allocator, Page Thread bridge, registry and product host remain single shared owners.
Pass the assembled prometeo.multi-surface-control-state/v1 through validateControlState before render; reject any candidate self-promotion or unresolved-route href.
Render through the existing coordination/candidates/multi-surface-control-v1 view. Do not create another shell/dashboard/control plane.

input_normalization_contract.opportunity_state: Use READY or READY_DERIVED only after durable dependency/readiness evaluation; static queue BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY is not enough to decide live readiness.
input_normalization_contract.mutation_identity: mutation_required=true is eligible only with resolved surface identity and owner; read-only verification may remain eligible under unresolved route identity.
input_normalization_contract.dedupe: canonical_fingerprint and collision_key must be stable durable identities; lower-ranked duplicates/collision peers are excluded.
input_normalization_contract.telemetry: working/returned/unread/problems/usefulFreeSlots are derived projections and sourceOfTruth remains false.

preview_contract.reason: All four consumed registry public routes are currently UNRESOLVED; this handoff does not guess a URL or claim Served.
preview_contract.truth_ceiling: Candidate coordination preview/build handoff only; browser/device E2E and exact product-route acceptance remain separate evidence gates.

acceptance_checks: exactly the four required surface ids are present
each surface keeps its local planner/steward owner
shared capabilities have one explicit owner
worker demand is derived after dependency/claim/collision/authority/privacy/identity gates
candidate state cannot set Human Accepted/Current/Served true
existing control view is reused rather than duplicated
next_owner: fresh verifier/critic or authorized candidate builder; not this integration recovery for production promotion
